modes.cue_notes: Lie on the belly and prop up on one forearm (or both in a Sphinx position). Bend one knee and bring the heel toward the same-side buttock. Use the same-side hand to hold the ankle and gently draw it toward the glute, creating a quadriceps stretch. Keep the hip of the bent leg on the floor. The other leg extends straight behind. Hold each side.

source: Traditional yin yoga; see Paul Grilley, Bernie Clark, Sarah Powers
notes: Targets the anterior thigh (quadriceps, rectus femoris) and hip flexors. The stomach meridian runs along the anterior thigh; kidney lines the lumbar area. A more accessible alternative before full Frog.
